<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{thm:general}
Assume conditions (\ref{ass:parameter-space})--(\ref{ass:maximization}) in Appendix~\ref{app:regularity}, which require in particular that $\boldsymbol{\theta}_0$ be interior to the fitted parameter set and that the Fisher information matrix be positive definite. Under $H_0$ and proportional exposure growth,
\begin{equation}
 T\xrightarrow{\;\;d\;\;}\tfrac12\delta_0+\tfrac12\chi_1^2,
 \label{eq:generallimit}
\end{equation}
where $\delta_0$ denotes a point mass at zero.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- proposition-1: body_md -->
\label{prop:gm}
Assume that the true $\lambda,\beta$ are strictly positive and that the identification and regularity conditions in Appendix~\ref{app:regularity} hold. Under $H_0$ and proportional exposure growth,
\begin{equation*}
 T\xrightarrow{\;\;d\;\;}\tfrac12\delta_0+\tfrac12\chi_1^2.
\end{equation*}
<!-- end proposition-1 -->
<!-- proposition-2: body_md -->
\label{prop:ggm}
Under $H_0$, assume $\gamma_0>0$ and that the identification and Fisher information conditions in Appendix~\ref{app:regularity} hold for the nuisance vector $(\log\lambda,\beta,\gamma)^\top$. Under proportional exposure growth,
\begin{equation*}
 T\xrightarrow{\;\;d\;\;}\tfrac12\delta_0+\tfrac12\chi_1^2.
\end{equation*}
<!-- end proposition-2 -->
